Three approximate values of the number 1 3 are given as 0.30, 0.33, and 0.34. Which of these three is the best approximation?

The best approximation will be the one which has the least absolute error. True value = 1 3 = 0.33333. Case I. Approximate value = 0.30 Absolute error = | True value – Approximate value | = | 0.33333 – 0.30 | = 0.03333 Case II. Approximate value = 0.33 Absolute error = | True value – Approximate value | = | 0.33333 – 0.33 | = 0.00333. Case III. Approximate value = 0.34 Absolute error = | True value – Approximate value | = | 0.33333 – 0.34 | = | – 0.00667 | = 0.00667 Since the absolute error is least in case II, 0.33 is the best approximation.
